text:
Jordan: FYI: customers reported duplicated usage after the multi-region failover on Sunday. raised by CS, looks like tokens counted twice for a handful of accounts
Sasha: any initial signal? same ingress node? same model family?
Mike: dug into kafka: we have repeated billing events with different upstream provenance but identical payloads. the retry path in the proxy reissued a message and regenerated the upstream event id
Chang: right — the proxy assigns a transient `handshake_uuid`. when failover happens some paths throw away the client-supplied id and we end up with new ids
Emma: had a reproduction: curl -> edge proxy -> retry -> ingest. proxy logs show original client id was present on the first attempt but the retry used a freshly minted id
Jordan: impact: 6 customers, ~8-15k tokens each on average. downstream rollups didn't collapse them because keys differed
Sasha: we need a canonical dedupe key that survives network retries and proxy replays. suggestion: prefer client-sent id (request_signature). fallback to deterministic payload fingerprint if absent
Mike: payload fingerprint details: canonicalize request body (strip ephemeral fields, stable map order, normalize whitespace, canonicalize prompt encoding) then sha256. include customer_id + model_id in the fingerprint so collisions across tenants are impossible
Chang: streaming/chunked requests: proxies can replay only later chunks. we should include stream_session_id and chunk_offset in the key for chunk-granularity dedupe
Emma: tradeoffs: fingerprinting is CPU-heavy at ingress. proposal: compute lightweight rolling hash at the edge and full sha256 in the central producer for a subset of events (sampling)
Sasha: reconciliation approach: keep raw events intact in the event log, but reconciler collapses by `billing_signature` within a 45s finality window. rule: prefer events marked `finalized=true` then earliest ingest_ts if multiple finals
Mike: schema changes: add `billing_signature` string and `ingress_provenance` array to avro. bump to billing_event_v4. emit `dedupe_alg=sha-v2` tag for visibility
Jordan: cross-version tokenization nuance: same prompt + different model versions can have different token counts. if client id matches but model_version differs, create a `model_version_mismatch` flag and route to the conflict queue for manual or automated resolution after 24h
Chang: automation idea: if matches client id AND model differs but token delta < 3 tokens, auto-resolve to the higher-cost event to be conservative
Emma: canary plan: select 5 internal test customers + 3 low-volume prod tenants exempt from auto-enforcement for week 1. during canary, reconciler marks duplicates but does not auto-correct billing; after confidence window, flip auto-collapse on
Sasha: monitoring: create signal `billing.collapse.delta_pct` and alert if >0.5% change in billed tokens for any customer post-collapse. also add a metric for `reconciler.collapsed_count` and `conflicts_queued`
Mike: backfill: run candidate backfill for last 60 days. script will compute new signatures and produce a reconciliation diff report rather than changing invoices automatically. ops will review high delta accounts
Jordan: owners: Mike (ingress + schema), Emma (reconciler + tests), Sasha (alerts + rollout), Chang (edge proxy behavior), Jordan (coordination + CS comms)
ingest-bot: schema push queued: schema_registry/avro/billing_event_v4 -> staging @Mike
billing-bot: incident alert created: DUP-TOKENS-FAILOVER-003 -> oncall notified @Sasha
Sasha: timeline: staging changes by Thu EOD, canary 2 weeks, full rollout conditional on <0.5% unexpected delta and zero major conflicts
Emma: I'll add unit tests for canonicalize(), streaming chunk scenarios, and a small perf test for fingerprinting CPU cost
Mike: I'll implement lightweight prehash in proxy and full canonicalization in ingestor, plus the kafka field emissions
Chang: I'll audit proxy retry paths to preserve client request_signature where possible and add a small header passthrough check
Jordan: action items recap: RFC doc for canonicalization rules, PRs for schema & reconciler, canary customer list, backfill job, alert dashboards, and CS notes for held/conflict cases
Sasha: leaving notes for CS: any held events flagged `model_version_mismatch` will be visible on the billing audit page with a short TTL
Jordan: thanks all. keep this thread for rollout updates. ping if you hit a blocker
